title: I Am An AI Hater. “But I am a hater, and I...
content: I Am An AI Hater. “But I am a hater, and I will not be polite. The machine is disgusting and we should break it. The people who build it are vapid shit-eating cannibals glorifying ignorance. I strongly feel that this is an insult to life itself.”
author: Jason Kottke
